name: Khoai deo
summary: Sun-dried slices of red sweet potato, chestnut brown and leathery, sold to take home. A 15 March 2023 visitor article says the potato is boiled, sliced, and dried 9–12 days on sand over rười grass. Buy it at Chợ Đồng Hới or chợ Nam Lý. A price is check on arrival.
origin: Dong Hoi. A 15 March 2023 visitor article on the provincial desk describes the dried sweet potato.
history: The 15 March 2023 article gives the method and no founding date. Red sweet potato is boiled, sliced, and sun-dried for 9–12 days on sand over a layer of rười grass until the slice is chestnut brown and leathery.
culture: It is a thing to take home, not a café serving. The same article says you buy it at Chợ Đồng Hới and chợ Nam Lý. Nam Lý is only that buy-line, not a second food street. The 2023 food fair on Bảo Ninh sold it with the dried seafood.
texture: The article’s finished slice is chestnut brown and leathery after those days in the sun.
howToEat: Buy the slices and take them home. The article does not describe a café plate or a tea ritual.
The morning market run is the hour it points at. A per-piece price was on that page and is not copied. The price is check on arrival.
where: Chợ Đồng Hới, on Mẹ Suốt, and chợ Nam Lý. Nam Lý is a buy-line in the article, not its own market page.
seoTitle: Khoai deo in Dong Hoi — sun-dried sweet potato
seoDescription: Red sweet potato, boiled, sliced, and sun-dried 9 to 12 days until chestnut brown. Buy it at Dong Hoi Market or chợ Nam Lý. A price is check on arrival.
